first_error_behavior: validateAll and Save preflight stop at the first rejection; blur/change handlers may mutate values independently.

rules.condition: A negative-format money field loses focus.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Legacy formatting permits parentheses/sign conversions and binary float rounding.
rules.official_behavior: Legacy formatting permits parentheses/sign conversions and binary float rounding.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use signed decimal validation and formatting.

rules.condition: A tax rate is at least 100.

rules.official_behavior: Resets the rate to 0.00 and focuses the field.

rules.condition: A date fails MM/DD/YYYY calendar validation.
rules.accepted_behavior: Condition is false and processing continues.
rules.rejected_behavior: Clears the value; numeric test uses isNaN(a || b || c), so only the first truthy component is directly tested.

rules.official_behavior: Clears the value; numeric test uses isNaN(a || b || c), so only the first truthy component is directly tested.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse all components with a strict calendar parser.

rules.official_behavior: Function expects a day field although the January 2018 return period is month/year; validateAll instead calls checkDate.
